race.comment: MYSTIC MOTIVER (2) was far from disgraced when fifth from the back row last start at Melton. Had kicked off the campaign with back-to-back seconds, one of them from this barrier. Race fit now and is good enough to take out a race like this. EVA EXPRESS (1) hasn't been too far off the placings in her three starts to date and should get every chance from the ace draw. RETRO FIT (5) continued her consistent form but found one better last time out, chasing along the sprint lane to be beaten 6 metres at Melton. Draws wider but looks close to a win. TAMALIA (3) was solid when coming from this barrier for fourth at Swan Hill last time out and should be at peak fitness now.
